global_prompt: A continuous cinematic kitchen close-up with shallow depth of field. The same chef continues refining a plated chocolate dessert at the stainless steel counter. The dessert, plate, counter, kitchen lighting, and softly blurred background remain visually consistent.

He nudges the mint leaf slightly to one side, aligning it more precisely with the curve of the frosting.
He adjusts the angle of the leaf with a tiny controlled movement, making it look balanced and intentional.
The camera subtly glides closer, emphasizing the leaf, the frosting texture, and the chef's careful hand motion.
The chef pauses with his hand hovering just above the plate, evaluating the composition of the dessert.
